Here I am going to create a function to parse a string of values
and add based to the base data frame.

```{r}
#uses a vector of 100 values
addNewSongCue <- function(songVector){
  #sifts through each value
  for(i in 1:length(songVector)){
    #Find the song in the base data frame
    #define index to failsafe the song not being in the vector.
    index<-0
    for(j in 1:588){
      if(tolower(SongCue$SongName[j]) == tolower(songVector[i])){
        #setting index to j when they find the right name
        #will end the loop and find the correct index
        #to add to.
        index=j
        break
      }
    }
    if(i==1 && index!=0){
      SongCue$FirstSong[index]<-SongCue$FirstSong[index]+1
    } 
    if(i<=10 && index!=0){
      SongCue$InTopTen[index]<-SongCue$InTopTen[index]+1
    }
    if(i<=25 && index!=0){
      SongCue$InTopTwentyFive[index]<-
        SongCue$InTopTwentyFive[index]+1
    } 
    if(i<=50 && index!=0) {
      SongCue$InTopFifty[index]<-SongCue$InTopFifty[index]+1
    } 
    if(i<=100 && index!=0) {
      SongCue$InTopOneHundred[index]<-
        SongCue$InTopOneHundred[index]+1
    }
  }
  return(SongCue)
}
```

```{r}
chiFirstSong<-0
chiTopTen<-0
chiTopTwentyFive<-0
chiTopFifty<-0
chiTopHundred<-0
freqBase<-as.vector(freqBase)
for(ind in 1:length(freqFirstSong)){
  chiFirstSong<-chiFirstSong+(((freqFirstSong[ind]-freqBase[ind])^2)/freqBase[ind])
}
for(ind in 1:length(freqTopTen)){
  chiTopTen<-chiTopTen+(((freqTopTen[ind]-freqBase[ind])^2)/freqBase[ind])
}
for(ind in 1:length(freqInTopTwentyFive)){
  chiTopTwentyFive<-chiTopTwentyFive+(((freqInTopTwentyFive[ind]-freqBase[ind])^2)/freqBase[ind])
}
for(ind in 1:length(freqInTopFifty)){
  chiTopFifty<-chiTopFifty+(((freqInTopFifty[ind]-freqBase[ind])^2)/freqBase[ind])
}
for(ind in 1:length(freqInTopOneHundred)){
  chiTopHundred<-chiTopHundred+(((freqInTopOneHundred[ind]-freqBase[ind])^2)/freqBase[ind])
}
pFirst<-pchisq(chiFirstSong,5,lower.tail = FALSE)
pFirst
pFirst>.05
pTen<-pchisq(chiTopTen,5,lower.tail = FALSE)
pTen
pTen>.05
pTFive<-pchisq(chiTopTwentyFive,5,lower.tail = FALSE)
pTFive
pTFive>.05
pFifty<-pchisq(chiTopFifty,5,lower.tail=FALSE)
pFifty
pFifty>.05
pHundred<-pchisq(chiTopHundred,5,lower.tail=FALSE)
pHundred
pHundred>.05
```
